member.summary: Applies DI-supplied dependencies to this (already-running) instance without re-triggering an initial fetch, so the eagerly-populated service list is preserved. The background poll is re-registered against the DI-supplied refresh interval, and the previous wait handle is unregistered. Used to let DI consumers share the same instead of spinning up a second background poller.
